subject: BUILD and SHINY APP using a package that is not in CRAN

messages.author: 8043a07baed42c72
messages.subject: BUILD and SHINY APP using a package that is not in CRAN
parts:
Hi all, 

I'm trying to build a Shiny app that requires a package (Pyramid) that is not in CRAN. 

The app is working good locally but once I try to deploy it, I get an error message telling me:

ERROR: cannot extract package from ‘timriffe-Pyramid-7f8b4f7.tar.gz


I try to solve the problem by adding the following lines to the code but the problem persists: 

library(devtools)
install_github("timriffe/Pyramid", subdir = "Pyramid")
library(Pyramid)


Can anyone give me a hint about how to solve this issue? Thanks in advance

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] BUILD and SHINY APP using a package that is not in CRAN
parts:
Hi,

Unfortunately, this is a bug in ShinyApps. The subdir parameter to devtools::install_github isn't supported by ShinyApps. I will take a peek and see what it will take to fix this.

-Andy
